gyro.cause: Gyroscope reporting bad or inconsistent data - often vibration, or a genuine IMU hardware fault.
gyro.fix: Keep the vehicle still and level, then reboot - ArduPilot calibrates gyros automatically on startup. If it persists, check for vibration or a faulty IMU.

accel.cause: Accelerometer readings are missing, inconsistent between IMUs, or have never been calibrated.
accel.fix: Run Accelerometer Calibration (6-position) from the Accel Cal tab.

mag.cause: Compass is uncalibrated, disconnected, or reporting inconsistent readings - often magnetic interference.
mag.fix: Run Compass Calibration, and mount the compass away from power wires/motors if interference persists.

baro.cause: Barometer isn't responding or its readings are inconsistent - often a blocked port or a wiring fault.
baro.fix: Check the barometer's air port isn't covered or foam-blocked, and confirm it's properly connected.

airspeed.cause: Airspeed sensor (pitot tube) is unplugged, blocked, or not calibrated - only relevant on Plane.
airspeed.fix: Check the pitot tube isn't blocked or covered, and run an airspeed calibration.

gps.cause: No GPS fix, too few satellites, or the GPS module isn't wired or configured correctly.
gps.fix: Give the GPS a clear view of the sky and wait for a 3D fix; check wiring/SERIALx_PROTOCOL if it never gets one.

opticalFlow.cause: Optical flow sensor isn't detecting motion reliably - usually poor lighting or a low-texture surface below.
opticalFlow.fix: Fly over a well-lit, textured surface, and confirm the sensor's height above ground is within its rated range.

visionPosition.cause: An external vision positioning system (e.g. a companion computer running VIO/SLAM) isn't sending valid position data.
visionPosition.fix: Check the companion computer/vision system is running and its MAVLink link to the flight controller is healthy.

laserPosition.cause: A rangefinder-based positioning source isn't reporting valid data.
laserPosition.fix: Check the rangefinder's wiring, and that it has a valid surface within range beneath it.

externalGroundTruth.cause: An external ground-truth positioning reference (used for simulation/testing) isn't reporting.
externalGroundTruth.fix: Check the external ground-truth source is connected and sending data - this is rare outside of simulation.

rateControl.cause: The rate controller can't reliably control roll/pitch/yaw rates - usually a downstream symptom of a gyro or motor/ESC problem.
rateControl.fix: Check gyro health first, then motor/ESC wiring - this bit tends to clear once the root sensor issue is fixed.

attitudeStabilization.cause: Attitude control (self-leveling) isn't working reliably - usually a downstream symptom of accelerometer, gyro, or compass health.
attitudeStabilization.fix: Resolve any accel/gyro/compass health issues first - this bit is a summary, not an independent sensor fault.

yawPosition.cause: The vehicle doesn't have a reliable heading reference - almost always an uncalibrated or interfered compass, or a compass/GPS yaw disagreement.
yawPosition.fix: Run Compass Calibration; if it still fails, check for magnetic interference near the compass and confirm GPS has a good fix.

altitudeControl.cause: Vertical position/altitude estimate isn't reliable - usually a barometer fault, a blocked baro port, or a rangefinder conflicting with the baro estimate.
altitudeControl.fix: Check the barometer isn't blocked or covered, and that any active rangefinder is reporting sane values.

positionControl.cause: Horizontal position estimate isn't reliable - almost always no or poor GPS fix, but can also be estimator variance from a bad compass or vibration.
positionControl.fix: Wait for a good 3D GPS fix outdoors with a clear sky view; if GPS is fine, check compass health and vibration levels.

motorOutputs.cause: A motor/servo output channel isn't configured, or a fault was detected on it.
motorOutputs.fix: Check SERVOx_FUNCTION assignments in Motors & Servos, and confirm every expected ESC/servo is wired and powered.

rcReceiver.cause: No RC signal is being received - receiver unplugged, unbound, or in failsafe.
rcReceiver.fix: Check the receiver is powered, bound to the transmitter, and the transmitter is switched on.

gyro2.cause: The secondary IMU's gyroscope is unhealthy - same causes as the primary gyro, but on the second IMU.
gyro2.fix: Same as Gyro: check for vibration, or a fault specific to the second IMU.

accel2.cause: The secondary IMU's accelerometer is unhealthy or uncalibrated.
accel2.fix: Re-run Accelerometer Calibration - it calibrates every detected IMU, including the second one.

mag2.cause: The secondary compass is unhealthy, uncalibrated, or disagrees with the primary compass.
mag2.fix: Re-run Compass Calibration - it calibrates every detected compass together.

geofence.cause: The vehicle is currently outside its configured geofence, or the fence itself is misconfigured.
geofence.fix: Check the fence boundary/radius against the vehicle's current position - this clears once back inside the fence.

ahrs.cause: The attitude/position estimator isn't confident in its solution - usually caused by inconsistent GPS, compass, or accelerometer data, or the vehicle being moved during startup.
ahrs.fix: Keep the vehicle still while powering on, and resolve any GPS/compass/accel health issues - AHRS health is a summary of those.

terrain.cause: Terrain elevation data needed for the current mode/mission isn't available.
terrain.fix: Ensure TERRAIN_ENABLE is set and terrain data has been downloaded/cached for the operating area.

reverseMotor.cause: ArduPilot detected a motor spinning the wrong direction for its position in the frame.
reverseMotor.fix: Check ESC/motor wiring against the expected frame layout in Motors & Servos, and correct the wiring or SERVOx_REVERSED.

logging.cause: Onboard logging isn't working - usually a missing, full, or corrupted SD card.
logging.fix: Check the SD card is inserted, has free space, and is formatted correctly (FAT32).

battery.cause: The battery monitor isn't reporting valid readings - a wiring fault, wrong BATT_MONITOR setting, or voltage below the arming threshold.
battery.fix: Check the battery monitor wiring and BATT_MONITOR configuration in Battery Config, and confirm the battery is charged.

proximity.cause: A proximity/obstacle sensor (e.g. a 360° lidar) isn't reporting valid data.
proximity.fix: Check the proximity sensor's wiring, and that it isn't obstructed or facing a surface it can't range.

satcom.cause: A satellite communication link isn't connected or isn't getting a signal.
satcom.fix: Check the satcom modem's wiring/power and that it has a clear view of the sky.

obstacleAvoidance.cause: The obstacle avoidance system is unhealthy - usually a downstream symptom of the proximity sensor(s) it depends on.
obstacleAvoidance.fix: Resolve any proximity-sensor health issues first - this bit is a summary, not an independent fault.

propulsion.cause: A non-standard propulsion system (e.g. an EFI engine) is reporting a fault.
propulsion.fix: Check the engine/EFI system's own status and wiring - this is specific to non-electric propulsion setups.

logs.heading: Log Data
logs.description: Drop a .skylog or .bin file. One skylog can contain several boards - the tool figures out each flight's board on its own. Everything is computed locally.

help.summary: How to enable the full skylog (-extended_log flag)
help.intro: Without the -extended_log flag, Skyline only logs the raw {tlm:...} record, and the numbers can only be recovered from .bin. To get decoded telemetry:
steps: Right-click the Skyline LRS shortcut → Properties.
In the Target field, after the closing quote, add a space and -extended_log.
Save and launch Skyline through this shortcut - new logs will have full telemetry.

geotag.heading: GeoTag
geotag.description: Match photos from a mapping flight to the vehicle's own logged camera-trigger positions (ArduPilot's CAM dataflash message), then write real GPS EXIF into geotagged copies - ready for Pix4D, DroneDeploy, WebODM, or any other photogrammetry tool. Needs a real .bin log with camera triggers logged.
geotag.desktopOnly: GeoTag needs the desktop app (reads/writes real files on disk) - not available in the plain browser build.
geotag.loadingLog: Reading camera-trigger records from the log...
geotag.noCamRecords: No CAM (camera-trigger) records found in this log - GeoTag needs a mapping mission that actually fired the camera, and a real .bin dataflash log (not .skylog).
